Precession constant from one or more single-valued cycles

Source: R/k_from_cycles.R
k_from_cycles.Rd

Each cycle is read as a named astronomical term and inverted directly: k = 360*3600 / (f_observed - f_term). Uncertainty is propagated by Monte Carlo over the cycle's own uncertainty (frequency resolution or `tol`) and over the secular frequencies at that age.

Usage

k_from_cycles(
  cycles,
  age_ma,
  record_length_kyr = NULL,
  tol = NULL,
  mult = 1,
  nsim = 20000,
  method = c("angular_momentum", "astrogeo22"),
  combine = c("multiply", "pool"),
  seed = NULL,
  tuned_to = NULL,
  anchor_term = "e405",
  sampleorb = "U",
  g4g3_range_kyr = NULL,
  s4s3_range_kyr = NULL,
  s3_uncertainty = c("published", "scaled"),
  data_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

cycles

Measured cycle periods in kyr (named numeric vector); every name is the astronomical term the cycle is read as, e.g. c("k+s3" = 30.8, "k+g5" = 19.9). Terms with k ("k+s3", "k+g5", "k+g2", "k+g4", "k+g3", ...) give the precession constant; terms without k (e.g. "e405", "g2-g5") only constrain the secular frequencies (element secular of the output). astro_terms lists the names that can be used. Required (no default).

age_ma

Age of the record in Ma (numeric): one value, or c(min, max) to draw the age uniformly from that range in the Monte Carlo simulation. Required (no default).

record_length_kyr

Length of the analysed record in kyr (numeric, > 0); with it the uncertainty band of each cycle is set by the frequency resolution mult / record_length_kyr (see cycle_band). NULL uses the relative half-width tol instead. Default=NULL.

tol

Relative half-width of the uncertainty band of each cycle, used only when record_length_kyr is NULL (numeric, > 0; 0.05 is plus or minus 5%). NULL gives 0.05 (see cycle_band). Default=NULL.

mult

Multiple of the frequency resolution 1 / record_length_kyr used as half-width of the band (numeric, > 0; 1 is plus or minus one bandwidth). Default=1.

nsim

Number of Monte Carlo draws (integer, >= 0); within its band each cycle is drawn uniformly. 0 gives the plain point estimate without uncertainty. Default=20000.

method

How the precession constant is converted to Earth-Moon distance, length of day and obliquity (character, passed to ctest_earthmoon and earthmoon_state): "angular_momentum" (conservation of Earth-Moon angular momentum) or "astrogeo22" (inversion of the AstroGeo22 curve of Farhat et al., 2022). Default=c("angular_momentum", "astrogeo22"), i.e. "angular_momentum".

combine

How the estimates of several k terms are combined (character): "multiply" (product of the individual densities, as in Zeeden et al., 2023, via ctest_combine) or "pool" (all samples together). Default=c("multiply", "pool"), i.e. "multiply".

seed

Seed of the random number generator (integer), so that the Monte Carlo results can be reproduced; NULL leaves the current random state unchanged. Default=NULL.

tuned_to

If the record was tuned, the period in kyr that was assumed for the tuning target (numeric, e.g. 405). The true duration of that target at this age is uncertain, so every measured period is stretched by (true target period)/tuned_to to propagate that error. NULL treats the input periods as true durations. Default=NULL.

anchor_term

Astronomical term of the tuning target (character; a secular difference without k, e.g. "e405" or "g2-g5"); only used when tuned_to is given. Default="e405".

sampleorb

Shape of the distribution from which the uncertain secular frequencies g2, g3, g4, g5 and s3 are drawn (character): "U" uniform or "N" normal. Default="U".

g4g3_range_kyr

Range c(min, max) of the period of the g4-g3 term in kyr (numeric vector of length 2), drawn uniformly to allow for a chaotic resonance transition (g3 and g4 are moved symmetrically); NULL keeps g4-g3 at its La2004 value. Default=NULL.

s4s3_range_kyr

Range c(min, max) of the period of the s4-s3 term in kyr (numeric vector of length 2), drawn uniformly as for g4g3_range_kyr; NULL keeps s4-s3 at its La2004 value. Default=NULL.

s3_uncertainty

How the uncertainty of s3 is applied (character): "published" uses the relative uncertainty directly as standard deviation of the s3 period in years, as in the published code; "scaled" multiplies it by the s3 period (a much wider spread). Default=c("published", "scaled"), i.e. "published".

data_dir

Folder that contains the data tables AstroGeo22.txt and La04gisi.csv (character path). NULL uses getOption("cocoR.data") or the copies installed with WaverideR. Default=NULL.

Value

list: `per_term` (one row per cycle), `combined` (k and Earth-Moon state), `samples`, and `consistent` (do the per-term 95% intervals overlap)
